exercises.title: Lab 3 — CT Library: encapsulation and data rules
exercises.problemHtml:
Ticket CTL-3. Tighten the data rules and pass the encapsulation review: a publication year can be neither before 1450 nor in the future; an email must have a valid shape and must not belong to another member; a book can be deleted (and its id is never handed out again); menu 8 prints library statistics. Every field is private, every number and sentence lives in Constants/Message, and lint.py reports 0 violations.

Your TODOs are listed below; the walkthrough (with the reviewer’s questions) is lesson Lab 3 of the course.

Project layers (LAB211 review standard): constants (Message, Constants) · model · dto · repository (keeps the data, CRUD) · service (business rules on data the controller hands it) · controller · view · utils (Validation) · main (menu, Scanner). Main class main.Main.

Your TODOs in the starter (search "TODO" — NetBeans: Window › Action Items):

  • src/repository/BookRepository.java:71 — TODO Lab 3.4 — book = findBookById(id); null thi throw ERROR_BOOK_NOT_FOUND;
  • src/repository/MemberRepository.java:71 — TODO Lab 3.3 — duyet memberList, email trung (equals) thi tra ve thanh vien do
  • src/service/BookService.java:56 — TODO Lab 3.5 — duyet bookList: cong totalCopies, dem sach copies == 0 (outOfStockTitles),
  • src/utils/Validation.java:74 — TODO Lab 3.1 — nam lon hon nam hien tai cua may
  • src/utils/Validation.java:115 — TODO Lab 3.2 — trim + toLowerCase; khong khop Constants.REGEX_EMAIL

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Finish every TODO; keep each class in its layer (no Scanner outside main, no printing outside view/main).
  • Case 1 replays the lab’s official harness input; the hidden cases use other data and other wrong inputs.
  • The grader also checks the LAB211 review rules L1–L7 (no System.exit, only nextLine(), List/Map declarations, no empty catch, private fields, switch with default, @Override).

const HERE = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const SHOW = args.includes('--show');
const RECORD = args.includes('--record') ? args[args.indexOf('--record') + 1] : null;
const ONLY = args.includes('--case') ? Number(args[args.indexOf('--case') + 1]) : null;
const WIN = process.platform === 'win32';
const color = process.stdout.isTTY && !process.env.NO_COLOR;
const paint = (c, s) => (color ? `\x1b[${c}m${s}\x1b[0m` : s);
const ok = (s) => paint('32', s), bad = (s) => paint('31', s), dim = (s) => paint('2', s), bold = (s) => paint('1', s);
const ra = (s = '') => process.stdout.write(s + '
');

// ── hidden cases are stored encoded so the problem stays a puzzle (ca ẩn được mã hoá) ──
const CASES = DE.cases.map((c) => (c.h ? { ...JSON.parse(Buffer.from(c.h, 'base64').toString('utf8')), hidden: true } : c));

// ── 1. find javac / java ──
function tool(name) {
  const exe = name + (WIN ? '.exe' : '');
  const fromHome = process.env.JAVA_HOME ? path.join(process.env.JAVA_HOME, 'bin', exe) : null;
  for (const cand of [name, fromHome].filter(Boolean)) {
    const r = spawnSync(cand, ['-version'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
    if (!r.error) return { cmd: cand, version: `${r.stdout || ''}${r.stderr || ''}`.trim() };
  }
  return null;
}
const javac = tool('javac');
const java = tool('java');
if (!javac || !java) {
  ra(bad('✘ javac/java not found — install a JDK first (Không tìm thấy javac/java — cài JDK trước).'));
  ra('  Windows: install "Eclipse Temurin JDK 17" (adoptium.net), tick "Set JAVA_HOME" + "Add to PATH", open a NEW terminal.');
  ra('  macOS:   brew install openjdk@17  (or the .pkg from adoptium.net), then open a new Terminal.');
  ra('  Check / Kiểm tra:  javac -version   and   java -version');
  process.exit(2);
}
const major = (() => {
  const m = /(?:javac|version)\s+"?(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?/.exec(javac.version) || [];
  const a = Number(m[1]);
  return a === 1 ? Number(m[2]) : a;
})();
if (major && major < DE.javaMin) {
  ra(bad(`✘ Your javac is Java ${major}; this exercise needs Java ${DE.javaMin}+ (Bài này cần Java ${DE.javaMin} trở lên).`));
  ra('  Install JDK 17 or 21 and put it first in PATH (or set JAVA_HOME), then run again.');
  process.exit(2);
}

// ── 2. collect sources (src/ = your code · cham/ = the grader's test classes) ──
function walk(dir, out = []) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return out;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const p = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(p, out);
    else if (e.name.endsWith('.java')) out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}
const mine = walk(path.join(HERE, DE.src));
const extra = DE.extra.flatMap((d) => walk(path.join(HERE, d)));
if (!mine.length) {
  ra(bad(`✘ No .java file under ${DE.src}/ — put your code there (Không thấy tệp .java nào trong ${DE.src}/).`));
  process.exit(1);
}

ra(bold(`CuongThai Code Lab · ${DE.title}`));
ra(dim(`${javac.version.split('
')[0]} · ${mine.length} source file(s) in ${DE.src}/ · ${CASES.length} case(s) · ${DE.rules.length + (DE.lab211 ? LAB211().length : 0)} rule(s)`));

// ── 3. compile ──
const build = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ctcl-build-'));
const work = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ctcl-run-'));
const cleanup = () => { for (const d of [build, work]) { try { fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch { /* ignore */ } } };
process.on('exit', cleanup);
process.on('SIGINT', () => { cleanup(); process.exit(130); });
const cp = spawnSync(javac.cmd, ['-encoding', 'UTF-8', '-nowarn', '-d', build, ...mine, ...extra], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 24 });
if (cp.status !== 0) {
  ra(bad('✘ COMPILE ERROR — fix it first (Lỗi biên dịch — sửa trước đã):'));
  ra(String(cp.stderr || cp.stdout).split(/?
/).slice(0, 30).map((l) => '  ' + l.replace(HERE + path.sep, '')).join('
'));
  ra(bad(`
Score / Điểm: 0/${CASES.length + DE.rules.length + (DE.lab211 ? LAB211().length : 0)}`));
  process.exit(1);
}

// ── 4. run the cases ──
const norm = (s) => {
  let lines = String(s).replace(/
?/g, '
').split('
').map((l) => l.replace(/[ 	]+$/, ''));
  if (DE.loose) lines = lines.map((l) => l.replace(/[ 	]+/g, ' ').trim());
  while (lines.length && lines[lines.length - 1] === '') lines.pop();
  return lines;
};
const show = (s) => JSON.stringify(s ?? '').slice(1, -1);
function runCase(c) {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(work, 'case-'));
  for (const [f, text] of Object.entries(c.files || {})) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(dir, f)), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, f), text);
  }
  const sessions = c.sessions || [c.input ?? ''];
  let out = '', err = '', crash = null;
  sessions.forEach((input, i) => {
    if (crash) return;
    if (i > 0) out += `===== RESTART: session ${i + 1} (same folder, files kept) =====
`;
    const r = spawnSync(java.cmd, ['-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8', '-Dstdout.encoding=UTF-8', '-Dsun.stdout.encoding=UTF-8', '-Duser.language=en', '-Duser.country=US',
      '-cp', build, ...(c.argsJava || []), DE.main, ...(c.args || [])],
    { cwd: dir, input, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: DE.timeoutMs, maxBuffer: 1 << 24 });
    out += r.stdout || '';
    err += r.stderr || '';
    if (r.error && r.error.code === 'ETIMEDOUT') crash = `TIMEOUT after ${DE.timeoutMs} ms — an endless loop? (e.g. the menu never reads the exit choice) · quá giờ — vòng lặp vô tận?`;
    else if (r.status !== 0 || /Exception in thread|^Exception|Error: /m.test(r.stderr || '')) {
      crash = `CRASHED (exit ${r.status ?? r.signal}) · chương trình SẬP:
${String(r.stderr || '').split(/?
/).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6).map((l) => '      ' + l).join('
')}`;
    }
  });
  return { out, err, crash };
}

const results = [];
const record = [];
CASES.forEach((c, i) => {
  if (ONLY && ONLY !== i + 1) return;
  const r = runCase(c);
  record.push({ out: r.out, crash: r.crash });
  if (RECORD) return;
  const want = norm(c.expected), got = norm(r.out);
  const diffs = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < Math.max(want.length, got.length); k++) {
    if (want[k] !== got[k]) diffs.push(k);
  }
  const pass = !r.crash && diffs.length === 0;
  const label = `case ${i + 1}${c.hidden ? ' (hidden · ẩn)' : ''} — ${c.name}`;
  results.push(pass);
  ra(`${pass ? ok('✔') : bad('✘')} ${label}`);
  if (r.crash) ra(bad(`    ${r.crash}`));
  if (diffs.length) {
    ra(`    ${diffs.length} line(s) differ (dòng khác) — expected ${want.length} line(s), you printed ${got.length}:`);
    for (const k of diffs.slice(0, 6)) {
      ra(`    line ${k + 1}:`);
      ra(`      expected / cần : ${k < want.length ? `"${show(want[k])}"` : dim('(no line · không có dòng)')}`);
      ra(`      yours / bạn in: ${k < got.length ? `"${show(got[k])}"` : dim('(no line · thiếu dòng)')}`);
    }
